subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the shared meeting-browser Plugin SDK require every plugin to adopt `meetingUrl` immediately, or should Teams use an additive/defaulted permission-plan API while external plugin authors migrate?
rationale: The proposed required callback changes a published plugin contract; code review cannot determine whether a breaking SDK change is an intended release policy.

options.title: Preserve an additive SDK migration
options.body: Keep the prior permission-plan call shape usable while supplying the meeting URL to plugins that opt into the new input.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK contract change
options.body: Accept the required meeting URL input only with explicit maintainer-visible release and migration direction for external plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Preserve an additive SDK migration
recommendation.body: Keep the prior permission-plan call shape usable while supplying the meeting URL to plugins that opt into the new input.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Teams plugin and authored the shared meeting-browser contract change.
